cv_summary: STEM Lead & Head of Physics candidate with three years' post-qualifying classroom experience delivering Pearson Edexcel IGCSE and A-Level Physics at Vision International School (Registered British Examination Centre), Tripoli. PGCEi candidate at Liverpool John Moores University (LJMU, UK) due 2026. B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering (University of Tripoli, 2020). Personally authored the school's full KS4/KS5 Edexcel Physics schemes of work, required practicals, and lab-safety procedures (CLEAPSS-aligned), and founded the engineering-linked STEM enrichment programme (industry visits, applied modelling). Concurrent appointment through 2024 at Kids Academy School (Cognia Accredited) for IGCSE/A-Level Physics intervention; prior KS3 Science and Chemistry at Ladybird International School (2022-2023). Engineering background (Alsahl Group, 2021-2022 - Technical Training & Diagnostics Specialist; Engineering Intern, Accuracy for Maintenance, 2020-2021) underpins uniquely credible delivery of Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Fluid Dynamics, and Electronics at GCSE and A-Level. Strong advocate of inclusive pedagogy, formative assessment (AfL), safeguarding, and current PGCEi continuing professional development.
